meta.title: INJU Boot Animation
meta.description: Plays the INJU 3D particle startup animation (WebGL2 · 60k particles · flower → moon → ghost text → solid logo) full-screen every time DeepSeek Harness starts, with an optional geek HUD / terminal layer. Every parameter is adjustable in Settings.
title: INJU Boot Animation
lead: Plays the INJU 3D particle animation from this project full-screen on every DeepSeek Harness start, then fades out. Every parameter below is saved and reused on the next start.
